items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / high quality game asset concept. Edit the supplied dimension-blockout washer into a polished production concept for a Korean old boarding-house psychological horror game. Preserve exactly the reference silhouette, overall 65 cm wide x 70 cm deep x 95 cm tall proportions, front loading door center, drawer placement, upright orientation and three quarter camera. One complete isolated washing machine on a neutral light grey studio background, generous margins, no other objects, no typography/dimension lines/logos/watermarks. Upgrade its primitive appearance: believable cream painted sheet steel with fine orange peel, folded seams, a realistically inset detergent drawer, subtly worn rotary knob with simple ticks, small aged green LED display, separate rubber door gasket and a dark glass door through which a perforated stainless drum is faintly visible, small realistic screws, recessed access cover, rubber feet. Restrained dirt collected at seams, very small scratches and mild yellowing; maintained second-hand appliance, not destroyed or bloodied. Detailed semi-realistic PC game asset art direction, grounded materials and convincing craftsmanship, neither cartoon nor toy nor raw Blender blockout. Soft neutral product lighting reveals details with natural contact shadow. Keep the reference body proportions rather than swapping in a generic shorter machine. No theatrical horror lighting.

Edit the reference simple cabinet into a high-quality semi-realistic PC horror game asset concept for an old Korean boarding house rooftop. Preserve the entire outline and 80cm width x40cm depth x120cm height proportions, same three-quarter view, two closed equal doors and low vents, no extra shelves outside. Single isolated asset fully in frame on light neutral gray studio background. Upgrade the primitive look with believable folded sheet-metal construction, rolled edges, narrow consistent door gaps, small external hinge knuckles, a tiny key lock, modest aged nickel handles, pressed narrow louver vents, sturdy shallow plinth. Faded muted sage green enamel, fine paint grain, tiny rust chips limited to exposed corners and lower edges, gentle grime in creases, a few small scuffs from everyday use. Not heavily wrecked or covered in graffiti. This is a practical 120cm high cleaning-supply cabinet, not a full-height locker or wardrobe. High-detail material definition, restrained realism like a well-made narrative game asset, not a cartoon and not glossy toy CGI. Keep doors closed for image-to-3D reconstruction, closed silhouette exactly matches reference. No objects on top, no text, branding or watermark. Soft studio lighting and accurate contact shadows. Remove black modeling artifacts or open seams from the blockout reference.

Edit the reference plain red toolbox into a high-quality semi-realistic game prop concept. Keep a single closed rectangular caretaker's metal toolbox with exact reference proportions 50cm wide x30cm deep x32cm high overall including its folded handle. Same three-quarter view, entire asset with generous margins, neutral light gray background, no other objects. Believable old Korean building maintenance toolbox: faded dark brick-red painted steel, pressed reinforcing ridges, a clear separate hinged lid, two detailed small tarnished steel toggle latches on front, a realistic black folded carry handle with visible pivot brackets, subtle seam gasket, small rounded corner caps, tiny fasteners. Distinct fine worn paint, little localized exposed steel at hand-contact points, restrained grime and mild corner oxidation. No big holes, no black rectangular artifacts from reference, no blood, no decoration, no tools outside, no logo or text. Preserve the broad low utility-box silhouette rather than tall luggage. Crisp realistic construction detail suitable for a close investigation camera in a polished modest-budget 3D game; not primitive blockout, toy, cartoon, or over-stylized fantasy. Soft neutral product lighting, no theatrical shadows, closed lid ready as image-to-3D reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit, architectural game environment material concept. The reference is the CODE-MATCHED geometry of our game, not loose inspiration. Turn its plain surfaces into an attractive polished semi-realistic 3D horror-game exterior render while preserving the exact building silhouette, camera angle and all structural geometry. Single very long 44m by11.3m THREE STOREY Korean gosiwon boarding house plus flat accessible rooftop. Keep EXACTLY twelve small 60x80cm bedroom windows in each of three rows, with the same offset positions, a total of36 on the long facade. Do not add, remove, enlarge or move windows. Keep the double entrance at the right of the image, the existing metal emergency stair on the right narrow end, and the staircase enclosure at the LEFT/back of the roof. Keep its roof access door, the low laundry canopy immediately beside that roof enclosure, and exactly three parallel laundry lines across the middle roof in the same positions. Preserve the entire roof parapet and empty roof circulation area. Material upgrade only: lower two floors use credible aged small warm-beige Korean facade tiles, subtle grout, rain streaks under sills, slight edge grime and gentle color variation. Third floor recently renovated with cleaner pale mineral render; same window geometry. Fine dark aluminum frames and slightly dirty reflective glass, a few dim warm interior windows matching reference. Roof has weathered muted sage waterproofing, patched joints and believable concrete coping; metal escape has proper galvanized steel texture and restrained oxidation. Keep the crude inter-storey dark gaps represented as recessed dark horizontal joints rather than inventing additional openings. Overcast late afternoon, neutral legible lighting with soft shadows; no heavy fog, pitch darkness or cinematic blur. Quality level of a carefully art-directed PC narrative horror game, not cartoon, not toy, not empty primitive blockout. Isolate the whole building against plain neutral gray studio ground and background, no neighboring buildings, no trees, no people, no cars, no extra freestanding props, no signs, no text or watermark. Entire building comfortably framed. This is a material/look-development concept; preserving all 36 windows and rooftop anchors is paramount.
